changelog:
- Initial release of the expense-policy skill.
- Generates clear, practical company expense and reimbursement policies with category limits, approval details, submission process, and exclusions.
- Prompts for missing key inputs like company context, expense categories, limits, and process.
- Produces a structured and easy-to-follow output format with examples and labelled placeholders.
- Emphasizes fairness, clarity, and user guidance while flagging tax/legal topics for review.
- Includes quality checks and anti-patterns to ensure completeness and prevent common policy issues.
summary: Write a clear company expense & reimbursement policy. Use when asked to write an expense policy, a reimbursement policy, a travel & expense (T&E) policy, or...
